page_title: NAN 3-5 MON | Nantes v Monaco 29/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+6' Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) jumps highest to meet an accurate cross and heads the ball towards the net. His fine header whistles just inches wide of the right post.
90+5' The referee blows his whistle after Mamadou Coulibaly (Monaco) does a good impression of a basketball player and handles the ball.
90+4' 3 - 5 Goal! 3:5. Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) taps home from almost on the goal line after a lucky rebound fell at his feet.

90+4' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball down to the middle of the goal. Anthony Lopes pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
90+1' Fabien Centonze (Nantes) goes for goal, but slices it wide of the target.
90+1' Ansu Fati (Monaco) tries his luck with a shot, but his effort goes wide of the target.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' Pape Cabral (Monaco) goes for goal but he blazes his shot well over the top.
89' Yellow card. Fabien Centonze (Nantes) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
84' Philipp Kohn (Monaco) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
82' Kassoum Ouattara (Monaco) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jerome Brisard had an easy-decision to make.
81' Here comes a substitution. Ansu Fati (Monaco) is brought on as a substitute for Maghnes Akliouche.
80' 3 - 4 Goal! Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) unleashes a first-time shot from inside the box and beats the goalkeeper into the roof of the net. 3:4.
76' Matthis Abline (Nantes) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
76' Luis Castro has decided to make a change. Fabien Centonze (Nantes) replaces Chidozie Awaziem.

75' 2 - 4 It's a goal! Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) shows off his superb ability as he volleys the ball from inside the box into the right side of the target. The assist goes to Kassoum Ouattara and the score changes to 2:4.
73' Sebastien Pocognoli decides to make a substitution. Folarin Balogun will be replaced by Mika Biereth (Monaco).
73' Folarin Balogun (Monaco) goes for goal but he blazes his shot well over the top.
71' Here's the change. Bahereba Guirassy leaves the pitch and Amady Camara (Nantes) comes on as a substitute.
71' Luis Castro has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) replacing Youssef El Arabi.
69' The referee signals a substitution. Pape Cabral (Monaco) is brought on as a substitute for Christian Mawissa.
69' Substitution. Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Takumi Minamino walks off.
68' Folarin Balogun (Monaco) is adjudged offside.
67' Christian Mawissa (Monaco) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
64' Here is a change. Hyeok-Kyu Kwon is going off and Luis Castro gives the last tactical orders to Nicolas Cozza (Nantes).
63' Substitution. Dehmaine Tabibou is replaced by Bahmed Deuff (Nantes).
62' Dehmaine Tabibou (Nantes) steps up to take the free kick, but his attempt to threaten the goal is unsuccessful as the ball flies way past the right post.
62' Jordan Teze (Monaco) sees a yellow card from Jerome Brisard after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
61' Thilo Kehrer (Monaco) argues strongly with the referee and is awarded a yellow card. A needless yellow card!
57' Mohammed Salisu (Monaco) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.

55' 2 - 3 What a goal! Kassoum Ouattara plays it to Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco), who finds himself unmarked inside the box and slots a first-time shot past Anthony Lopes into the bottom right corner. 2:3.
50' Kelvin Amian (Nantes) fires a wonderful strike towards goal, but it's a whisker wide of the left post.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+8' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+6' 2 - 2 Goal! Bahereba Guirassy (Nantes) gets a shot away from inside the box and the effort is deflected past the goalkeeper. 2:2.
45+6' Youssef El Arabi (Nantes) misses a golden opportunity after his strike hits the post!
45+2' Folarin Balogun (Monaco) takes a shot from inside the box and hits the right post!
45+2' The resulting set piece from Monaco is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
45+1' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
45' The fourth official shows 7 min. of added time.

41' 1 - 2 It's in the back of the net! Mamadou Coulibaly slips the ball through to Folarin Balogun (Monaco), and he darts into the box to unleash a magnificent low shot into the back of the net. He makes it 1:2.
38' The goalkeeper pulls off a great save to deny Bahereba Guirassy (Nantes), whose good effort would probably have ended inside the bottom right corner of the net.
36' The opposing goalkeeper had set up the wall well before the free kick was executed and Matthis Abline (Nantes) failed to send the ball over. Great defensive action!
34' A yellow card for a tackle by Takumi Minamino (Monaco). Jerome Brisard doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
32' The goal by Monaco won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
29' Celebrations by Monaco are cut short as the referee signals that the legality of the goal will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully this won’t take too long.
27' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) gets to the rebound in the goalmouth and plants a header home.
27' A header by Krepin Diatta (Monaco) from very close range goes towards the middle of the target, but doesn't get past Anthony Lopes, who makes a nice save.
27' Monaco force a corner. They send men into the box.
25' Jerome Brisard shows the yellow card to Mamadou Coulibaly (Monaco) for a heavy challenge.
19' 1 - 1 Goal! Matthis Abline passes the ball to the feet of Bahereba Guirassy (Nantes), who has an empty net in front of him and has no problems in tapping the ball in. 1:1.
17' Thilo Kehrer (Monaco) makes space inside the box for a shot, but his effort goes just wide of the left post.
16' Luis Castro is stunned as referee Jerome Brisard shows him a yellow card. What was that for?
16' Today's referee Jerome Brisard rightly decides to book Tylel Tati (Nantes) for his harsh tackle.
14' Folarin Balogun (Monaco) gets inside the box and only has the keeper to beat, but lashes his shot way over the bar.
12' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) misses a great opportunity from inside the penalty area after blasting the ball towards goal and it goes wide of the left post.

6' 0 - 1 It's a goal! Mamadou Coulibaly (Monaco) scores with a brilliant shot into the middle of the goal after being released inside the box by a superb lofted pass from Maghnes Akliouche. The score is now 0:1.
6' What a chance that is! Dehmaine Tabibou (Nantes) wastes a huge opportunity as he receives a beautiful pass inside the box but is somehow only able to prod the ball onto the crossbar!
3' The referee points to the corner flag and Nantes will take a corner.
3' Matthis Abline (Nantes) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
2' A corner kick by Monaco is thwarted by the well prepared Anthony Lopes (Nantes).
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and Nantes will have the kick-off.
Jerome Brisard is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
Show lineups
